d: Short, honey-blonde hair with choppy bangs and a side-swept style, paired with bright lime-green eyes and a cheerful, youthful expression. This adolescent individual has a slender build, wearing a red and white armored dress featuring a pleated skirt, a lime-green belt, silver pauldrons, and grey thigh-high boots. A white ribbon with pink tips is tied into a bow on the head, and a small ID badge hangs from a lanyard around the neck. The figure holds a long black spear with a silver and gold pointed tip.
